## Functional assignment

This 409-aa protein is **most likely a bacterial flavohemoprotein with nitric oxide dioxygenase (NOD) activity** (EC 1.14.12.17). Its closest reviewed match, *Bacillus thuringiensis* flavohemoprotein Q6HLA6, has **62.7% sequence identity across 98.8% of the query** (E-value 1.72 × 10⁻¹⁷⁸). Other close reviewed bacterial homologs have the same annotation.

The enzyme is associated with **aerobic nitric oxide detoxification**, converting nitric oxide (NO) to nitrate:

\[
2\,\mathrm{NO} + \mathrm{NADPH} + 2\,\mathrm{O_2}
\rightarrow 2\,\mathrm{NO_3^-} + \mathrm{NADP^+} + \mathrm{H^+}
\]

An NADH-dependent version of the reaction is also annotated for the homologs. The reference proteins bind **heme b and FAD**, which support the flavohemoprotein assignment.

**Confidence caveat:** This is a strong full-length homology-based assignment, not a direct experimental characterization of the supplied sequence. Exact cofactor occupancy and whether this particular protein uses NADH, NADPH, or both have not been established here.
